New photo added, to show the carnage of our backyard demolition process. This review is not about a poorly constructed pool. It is entirely the result of MCCP not honoring their word and their warranty - ghosting us so they can avoid the problem. data.summary: The reviews for this pool contractor appear overwhelmingly authentic. The high ratings are supported by a large volume of detailed positive reviews. The negative reviews are highly specific, credible, and reveal consistent complaint patterns (warranty issues, delays, cleanup) that are common in the construction industry. There is no evidence of systematic review manipulation; the profile is that of a generally well-regarded but imperfect contractor with some customer service and follow-through issues.
fake_signals: Some generic, non-specific 5-star reviews in the Google Local sample (e.g., reviews 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)
Multiple anonymous reviews on Google HQ (common but not definitive)
authentic_signals: Detailed negative reviews with specific complaints (tile failure, warranty denial, property damage)
Positive reviews mention specific staff names (Gregg, Eric, Craig, Josh, Scott, Mark, Don)
Positive reviews contain specific project details (timelines, design process, equipment quality)
Varied writing styles and emotional authenticity across all reviews
High volume of reviews (324 on Angi) is normal for an established contractor
complaint_patterns: Sloppy cleanup and damage to property
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across all consumer-facing platforms (Google, Yelp, Angi, Houzz). The BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling. The Glassdoor search results are for other similarly named companies, not the contractor in question.
